one_line: Verified: METU graduate project (May-Jun 2026, no LICENSE, 8.9 MB) on Turkey's Law No. 7464 national STR permit regime (in force 1 Jan 2024) using a single Inside Airbnb Istanbul cross-section pulled 29-30 Sep 2025 (listings.csv 30,051 rows x 79 cols; calendar.csv.gz ~10.9M rows, Sep 2025-Sep 2026). Committed under Data/: mgwr_summary.csv (35 KB - h3_cell, listing_count, unlicensed_rate, mean_price in TRY, GWR coefficients and significance at three bandwidths), istanbul_airbnb_h3.geojson (1.06 MB), six standalone HTML maps (0.3-4.3 MB each), four PNG figures, mgwr_bandwidths.txt; plus a 66 KB Spatial_Final_Version.py pipeline and a 45 KB README. The raw Inside Airbnb files and the 12-month booking series are NOT committed; the author notes 2023-2024 Istanbul history has been formally requested from Inside Airbnb.
abnb_use: Gap #12 with an EMEA market absent from our 32-factor regulatory database and municipal registry panel: an H3-cell unlicensed-rate and mean-price surface quantifies permit non-compliance 21 months after a national licensing shock, which is the kind of compliance-decay number we need for EMEA supply/nights risk, and the licence-field classification rule (permit number vs Exempt vs Non-real-estate vs NaN) is directly reusable on the licence column of our own 120-market Jun-2026 cohort.
sample_plan: curl -sL from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eda-yilmaz/DI722_Istanbul_Airbnb/main/ for: README.md (45 KB), Data/mgwr_summary.csv (35 KB), Data/mgwr_bandwidths.txt, Data/istanbul_airbnb_h3.geojson (1.06 MB), Spatial_Final_Version.py (66 KB). Total ~1.2 MB. Skip all six .html maps (up to 4.3 MB each, presentation only) and the PNGs.
